description: This is a Java source file defining the StatusWindow class, which provides a GUI component for displaying status messages within a larger application. It manages UI elements such as a text area for logs, a scroll pane, and frame handling, and includes methods for updating the display and showing the window.

classes.name: StatusWindow
classes.description: A GUI window class that displays log messages and related UI controls for the rusefi project.

methods.name: StatusWindow
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GUI components, including text area, panels, and labels.

methods.name: getFrameHelper
methods.description: Returns the FrameHelper instance managing this window's frame.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main content panel of the window.

methods.name: getFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the JFrame associated with this window.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Sets the window title, displays it, centers it on the screen, and clears the log text.

methods.name: appendMsg
methods.description: Appends a message to the log text area in a thread-safe way.
